aboutMe: Software engineer with over five years of experience in building and modernizing production applications in TypeScript, across React and Svelte. Designs abstractions other teams adopt and is biased toward reducing system complexity over adding frameworks. Trusted with release safety, production incidents, and delivery leadership.
heroAbout: Software engineer with over five years of experience building and modernizing production applications in TypeScript, across React and Svelte. I design abstractions other teams adopt and favor reducing complexity over adding frameworks.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer I
description: Designed a configuration-driven service request architecture that ships new service flows through configuration rather than new implementations, pairing filesystem symlinks with TypeScript type safety instead of a micro-frontend; adopted by other teams as a standard integration pattern, with seven service request types running on it and 19 other developers building on it.
Led frontend delivery enabling mobile sales on the company's internal, agent-facing platform, contributed to 35% YoY mobile sales growth, the strongest mobile year on company record.

Led team delivery for three months in the dev manager's absence, running sprint planning, refinement, and standups across Dev and QA and merging 65 of the team's 91 UI pull requests; cut the backlog 60% and met key product milestones.

Designed and implemented centralized role-based access control across client and server validation, introducing an app-wide redirect pattern and permission-aware form components extensible to new protected routes without rework.

Proposed and delivered the team's first AI-assisted developer tooling under manager sponsorship, shipped in three weeks: a Jira-integrated PR-review automation encoding the codebase's correctness, security, accessibility, and testing checks, used across 100+ personal review sessions over four months; established the repository structure and conventions that 12 subsequent tooling tickets from five engineers built on.

Owned frontend release safety, gating releases behind feature flags, setting up Google Cloud Monitoring for the app, and watching Beta and Prod logs through rollout; relied on to fix production issues, with 21 hotfixes shipped across 17 releases since June 2026.

Planned a phased Svelte 5 migration and landed the cutover, upgrading Svelte, the component library, and Vite across 169 files and patching every critical- and high-severity vulnerability; the remaining modernization continues by phase.

Led the refactor bringing the company's internal, agent-facing platform from desktop-only support to full iPad support in one sprint with no wireframes, extending it to door-to-door sales agents for the first time; deployed and fully usable for submitting customer orders within days of launch.

experience.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description: Built a React and Node.js/Express product-photos microservice (MongoDB, MERN stack) with a REST API and a shared styled-components design system, containerized with Docker and deployed through a CircleCI pipeline; automated test coverage with Jest and Enzyme to catch regressions during iterative deployment.

Designed and built a horizontally scalable backend system (Node.js, CouchDB, Redis caching, NGINX micro-caching) to sustain high read volume under cost constraints; load-tested with New Relic, Loader.io, and K6, cutting average latency from ~2,400ms to ~27ms while scaling throughput to ~3.4k requests/second, deployed as containerized services to AWS EC2 through a CI/CD pipeline.

experience.title: Provider Enrollment Specialist
description: Ran end-to-end and scenario-based testing on a statewide provider enrollment platform, surfacing frontend defects.
Worked directly with clients on the Vendor Drug Program rollout, helping ensure compliance with state contract requirements and smooth system adoption.
